rationale: mulDiv removes the product remainder before power-of-two factorization, normalizes a 512-bit product, and multiplies by the odd-denominator modular inverse using Newton-Raphson iterations. These flagged operations are deliberate exact/modular steps, not an economic division followed by accidental scale restoration. This is source reasoning, not a fresh formal proof or compiler-bug exclusion.

rationale: claimFromRouter and spend share nonReentrant protection. The immutable bound Router sends only this Vault credit to this Vault; exact credit reduction and physical receipt are verified before incrementing claimed. Fresh hostile-token/Treasury testing remains separate.

rationale: ExactAssetV2.pull is internal, not an externally callable arbitrary-from spender. In the reviewed closure Router.fund first requires msg.sender == immutable source, validates launch/asset/epoch/sequence, and passes that same msg.sender as from. No externally supplied victim from parameter reaches this call. Source and destination balance deltas are checked. This disposition covers this closure, not every other protocol use of ExactAssetV2.

Timelock intentionally invokes authorized targets before CallExecuted. _beforeCall checks readiness/predecessor and _afterCall rechecks readiness then marks done; reentry of the same completed operation makes outer execution revert atomically. Cross-operation execution remains subject to independently scheduled authorization. Log ordering requires truthful indexing; no asset-loss exploit demonstrated.
